title: G0 · Data and alignment
question: Do we have enough crypto markets, and do their windows line up with the spot candles?
headline: 276 markets with trades, 13,795 asset-minutes over 79 days; resolution matches the spot candle in 93.8% of markets.
notes: Pass rule: ≥ 500 markets with trades and ≥ 95% agreement between the resolution and spot(close) ≥ spot(open) over the market window.
A window shift is applied only if it beats the documented window by 5+ points of agreement.
